The description for `elseValue` in multiple places mentions "default value is returned when no condition matches," which is inconsistent with the actual behavior described elsewhere as returning the `elseValue`. This should be clarified to avoid confusion. In `case.asciidoc`, the table header for `result` should reflect that it can also be `null` if no condition matches and there is no `elseValue`.
